# Chronic Health

> Free iPhone and iPad app for keeping a complete daily record of symptoms, treatments, side effects and illnesses, so people with chronic conditions can walk into every appointment with the whole story. No account, no subscription, no ads; data stays on the device and exports in full.

## Docs

- [Product guide](https://chronichealth.jacksoncurtis.me/chronic-health-product-guide.md): every feature in detail, positioning, comparison with Bearable and Juno, FAQ
- [AI data guide](https://chronichealth.jacksoncurtis.me/chronic-health-ai-guide.md): how to read and interpret data a user exports from the app (zip, JSON, CSV)

## Optional

- [Support](https://chronichealth.jacksoncurtis.me/): support, feature overview and contact
